description: This file declares utility functions for parsing WebRTC session descriptions, ICE candidates, and error messages from JSON messages, as well as generating ICE server JSON messages within the 'cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming' namespace.

methods.name: ParseSessionDescription
methods.description: Parses a WebRTC session description from a JSON message given its type and message content.

methods.name: ParseIceCandidate
methods.description: Parses an ICE candidate from a JSON message.

methods.name: ParseError
methods.description: Parses an error message from JSON.

methods.name: ParseIceServersMessage
methods.description: Extracts ICE server configurations from a JSON message.

methods.name: GenerateIceServersMessage
methods.description: Generates a JSON message representing a list of ICE servers.
